system_description: A single-user desktop virtual pet that persists between sessions and decays against the real wall clock whether or not the application is running.

actors.name: Owner
actors.description: The single local desktop owner of one installation, who keeps the pet and exercises the care loop; requirements assumption A-1 admits no other role.
actors.relationship: views the pet and performs care actions

containers.name: Pet Webview UI
containers.description: The owner-facing surface rendered in the OS-supplied webview, hosted on the presentation surface the core hands it and driven across the Tauri IPC bridge.

containers.name: Pet Core
containers.description: The native process holding the pet simulation, its persistence and integrity rules, and the single platform-adapter layer through which every platform-specific behaviour passes.

reason: Two containers because runtime_and_stack names two runtimes in one installer — a Rust core and a system webview that cannot share a technology label and communicate only across Tauri's IPC seam, already encoded as IF-027, IF-017 and IF-030 — held at medium because that stack is recorded as provisional against Q-5's unmeasured reference machine.
